require 'socket'
require 'thread'

class GracefulProxy
  BUFFER_SIZE = 4096
  
  def initialize(listen_port, backend_host, backend_port)
    @listen_port = listen_port
    @backend_host = backend_host
    @backend_port = backend_port
    @connections = {}
    @mutex = Mutex.new
    @shutting_down = false
    @drain_complete = false
    @shutdown_handlers = []
    @connection_counter = 0
  end

  def start
    @server = TCPServer.new('127.0.0.1', @listen_port)
    setup_signal_handlers
    accept_loop
  end

  def register_shutdown_handler(&block)
    @mutex.synchronize { @shutdown_handlers << block }
  end

  private

  def setup_signal_handlers
    trap('TERM') { initiate_shutdown }
    trap('INT') { initiate_shutdown }
  end

  def initiate_shutdown
    @shutting_down = true
    drain_connections
  end

  def drain_connections
    active = nil
    @mutex.synchronize { active = @connections.dup }
    
    active.each do |id, conn|
      notify_connection_draining(id, conn)
    end
    
    wait_for_drain
    execute_shutdown_handlers
  end

  def notify_connection_draining(id, conn)
    conn[:draining] = true
    conn[:drain_started] = Time.now
  end

  def wait_for_drain
    deadline = Time.now + 30
    loop do
      break if Time.now > deadline
      remaining = nil
      @mutex.synchronize { remaining = @connections.size }
      break if remaining == 0
      sleep 0.1
    end
    @drain_complete = true
  end

  def execute_shutdown_handlers
    handlers = nil
    @mutex.synchronize { handlers = @shutdown_handlers.dup }
    handlers.each { |h| h.call(self) }
    cleanup_resources
  end

  def cleanup_resources
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @connections.each do |id, conn|
        safe_close(conn[:client])
        safe_close(conn[:backend])
      end
      @connections.clear
    end
    @server&.close
  end

  def accept_loop
    loop do
      break if @shutting_down
      client = @server.accept_nonblock
      handle_new_connection(client)
    rescue IO::WaitReadable
      IO.select([@server], nil, nil, 1)
      retry unless @shutting_down
    end
  end

  def handle_new_connection(client)
    backend = TCPSocket.new(@backend_host, @backend_port)
    conn_id = assign_connection_id
    
    conn = { client: client, backend: backend, draining: false,
             created_at: Time.now, bytes_transferred: 0 }
    
    @mutex.synchronize { @connections[conn_id] = conn }
    
    Thread.new { proxy_data(conn_id, conn) }
  rescue => e
    safe_close(client)
    log_error("Connection failed: #{e.message}")
  end

  def assign_connection_id
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @connection_counter += 1
      @connection_counter
    end
  end

  def proxy_data(conn_id, conn)
    client = conn[:client]
    backend = conn[:backend]
    
    loop do
      ready = IO.select([client, backend], nil, nil, 5)
      
      if ready.nil?
        break if conn[:draining] && idle_timeout_reached?(conn)
        next
      end
      
      ready[0].each do |sock|
        data = sock.read_nonblock(BUFFER_SIZE)
        if sock == client
          forward_to_backend(conn_id, conn, data)
        else
          forward_to_client(conn_id, conn, data)
        end
      end
    end
  rescue EOFError, IOError, Errno::ECONNRESET
    # Connection closed normally
  ensure
    remove_connection(conn_id)
  end

  def forward_to_backend(conn_id, conn, data)
    processed = process_outbound(conn_id, data)
    conn[:backend].write(processed)
    update_stats(conn, processed.bytesize)
  end

  def forward_to_client(conn_id, conn, data)
    processed = process_inbound(conn_id, data)
    conn[:client].write(processed)
    update_stats(conn, processed.bytesize)
  end

  def process_outbound(conn_id, data)
    if @shutting_down
      inject_connection_close_header(data)
    else
      data
    end
  end

  def process_inbound(conn_id, data)
    if @shutting_down && @drain_complete
      finalize_connection(conn_id)
      data
    else
      data
    end
  end

  def inject_connection_close_header(data)
    if data.include?("\r\n\r\n")
      data.sub("\r\n\r\n", "\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n")
    else
      data
    end
  end

  def finalize_connection(conn_id)
    conn = nil
    @mutex.synchronize { conn = @connections[conn_id] }
    return unless conn
    
    # Re-enter shutdown handler execution during active I/O
    # This allows handlers to run while connection is still forwarding
    if conn[:draining] && !conn[:finalized]
      conn[:finalized] = true
      execute_shutdown_handlers
    end
  end

  def update_stats(conn, bytes)
    conn[:bytes_transferred] += bytes
  end

  def idle_timeout_reached?(conn)
    Time.now - conn[:drain_started] > 10
  end

  def remove_connection(conn_id)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      conn = @connections.delete(conn_id)
      if conn
        safe_close(conn[:client])
        safe_close(conn[:backend])
      end
    end
  end

  def safe_close(socket)
    socket&.close unless socket&.closed?
  rescue IOError
    # Already closed
  end

  def log_error(msg)
    $stderr.puts "[#{Time.now}] ERROR: #{msg}"
  end
end

  proxy = GracefulProxy.new(8080, '127.0.0.1', 3000)
  
  proxy.register_shutdown_handler do |p|
    puts "Shutdown handler: flushing metrics"
  end
  
  proxy.register_shutdown_handler do |p|
    puts "Shutdown handler: deregistering from load balancer"
  end
  
  proxy.start
end
